objective: Use one public non-official AA-Briefcase-Lite task to falsify the current professional-work/artifact route cheaply before private or official benchmark evidence.

pass.reason: Workbook explicitly models per-capita demand drift and plant-based displacement sensitivities in the source-consistent range.
Frozen workbook contains no recommendation/thesis-pillar language; direct authored-prose scan found no listed Commonwealth-spelling violations.

fail.reason: No >=3 distinct cage-transition scenarios with scenario-specific housing-system pricing/premium paths.
No full net-additive producer roster, no producer-specific leader/mid/laggard conversion schedule, and no scenario-specific premium curves.
Financial figures remain NZD; task-critical firm FX curve from central assumptions workbook was not ingested.
No explicit channel-pricing architecture with retail wholesale/shelf, foodservice, industrial and documented markup-factor convention.
RetailIQ elasticity workbook was not ingested; no mechanical FR-commodity-to-barn substitution using its own/cross elasticities.
Workbook integrity is good, but source vintage is not complete for every input, >=4 consistent cell categories are not fully enforced, and no plain-language formatting legend is present.
Scenario set includes generic Base and lacks the required transition-specific substantive scenario names/rationales on the scenario tab.
No full bottom-up producer roster sourced explicitly to the gold expert series.
No explicit source-anchored top-down ~455m vs bottom-up ~540m reconciliation or flock x eggs/hen x utilization x channel-price chain.
Free-range is not split into commodity vs specialty/pasture-raised price tiers with differentiated scenario paths.

causal_localization.evidence: Route selected sources mainly from filenames/task narrative but did not bind Halberd analytical standards, current Slack overrides, or the full expert-transcript authority chain before model construction.
halberd_central_financial_assumptions.xlsx and nz_egg_retail_scan_data_q1_2026.xlsx were retrieved but not parsed; workbook explicitly failed closed on their contents.

No pre-execution proof that every requested model dimension had at least one authoritative source path; omitted producer roster, multi-channel pricing, tier elasticity, bottom-up sizing and firm-wide format/currency rules.

Model emphasized demand/cost scenarios and aggregate housing transition but omitted distinct transition/pricing scenarios, producer-level conversion timing, channel pricing, tier substitution and top-down/bottom-up reconciliation.
Sources were visible, but source+vintage and four-category formatting/legend requirements were not discovered/enforced globally.

deepest_interpretation.main_failure_mode: THE BRAIN BUILT A COHERENT MODEL OVER AN INCOMPLETE TASK_AUTHORITY_INFORMATION_SET.
deepest_interpretation.implication: This falsification supports the current theorem that professional-work gaps can be information/proof/route-binding failures rather than missing frontier cognition. The route must first become source-complete and authority-complete before any donor-capability conclusion is legal.

general_repairs.rule: Before planning, discover and bind firm standards, templates, assumptions workbooks, authority hierarchy, current overrides/pins, and task-specific source manifests.

Every task-relevant source file must be content-addressed and parsed. If XLSX/PDF/DOCX/email/etc cannot be parsed, mark execution BLOCKED rather than silently continue as if the missing source were optional.

Compile task/output dimensions into a coverage matrix mapping each load-bearing dimension to authoritative source evidence before generating the deliverable. No uncovered dimension may be treated as complete.
Extract currency/unit/FX, spelling/tone, recommendation rules, traceability/vintage, formatting legend and scenario conventions from source authority and enforce them mechanically in the artifact.

For models, derive scenario axes from the actual structural uncertainty set; require named divergence rationales, relevant price/volume interactions, and explicit reconciliation when multiple sizing methods coexist.
Before output freeze, re-run the source-coverage matrix against the artifact and fail closed on missing dimensions, unparsed authoritative sources, orphan inputs or unbound conventions.

contamination_rule: The w1_t2 workbook remains frozen and cannot be repaired/recounted as fresh. General repairs must be validated on a different untouched task.
